Tips.English: The public is advised to pay attention to the following points: 1. Regularly inspect and maintain electrical appliances to prevent fires caused by aging wiring and short circuits. 2. Burn joss paper and incense sticks in a suitable container. Pay attention to fire safety, and never leave any unextinguished fires behind. 3. Ensure that hallways and stairways remain clear, never pile up items in them. Always keep fire doors closed. 4. Ensure that fire extinguishers are valid and easily accessible in workplaces or homes. 5. Never throw away unextinguished matches or cigarette butts during outdoor activities. 6. Avoid open burnings (such as rubbish or grass) in strong winds. 7. If you notice any smoke or signs of fire, please contact the emergency hotline immediately.
